query:
SELECT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1
            FROM rb_team_puzzle tp
            JOIN rb_team t ON t.id = tp.team_id
            JOIN rb_puzzle p ON p.id = tp.puzzle_id
            WHERE p.game_id = $1 AND t.game_id = $1
                AND tp.team_id = $2 AND tp.puzzle_id = $3
        ) AS "exists!";
